summary: Splitting is not technically required and the generated plan is not safe to execute as written. The 44-file / 24-commit diff is one coherent intent: delete vacuous test/e2e files, add the lint that prevents their return, and repair every doc/spec ref that pointed at the deleted files. No foreign Story lineage; all 24 commits are this Story's or origin/main merges. Every repo-control edit is minimal and load-bearing. Conversely the plan's merge_order is unsafe and its lanes leave 3 changed paths uncovered, so shipping as one PR is the safer option. All findings are against the plan artifact, not the branch.

inspection.summary: Judged scope independently from git rather than from the plan: enumerated the 44 changed paths and 24 commits against origin/main, read the full diff of every repo-control file (.github/workflows/ci.yml, package.json, .vibepro/config.json, design-ssot.json) and the routing-profiles spec edits, then re-derived the plan's lane coverage and merge_order in Python against the real diff set. Scanned Story/Spec/Architecture/decision docs for reviewer-directed text and found none.
inspection.evidence: ci.yml + package.json diff shows the CI step and npm script co-dependency; recomputed lane coverage over split-plan.json lanes vs git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD = 41 of 44 paths covered; 4 findings (2 medium, 2 low), all against the split plan artifact

judgment_delta: initial judgment: 44 files and 24 commits touching CI, package.json, design-ssot.json and another Story's spec.json reads as classic mixed lineage that must be split -> final judgment pass as a single PR, because the routing-profiles and spec-doc edits only remove test_refs naming files this branch deletes and would leave dangling refs if landed separately, and because the generated plan's own merge_order lands ci.yml's new npm script as lane 1 while the script is defined in lane 4 and implemented in lane 3 with lanes branched independently from base, so executing the split would leave main's CI red across two intermediate merges while also dropping 3 changed paths that appear in no lane
